title: refactor: rename log() to logEvent() and tidy permission helpers
body: Mechanical rename of the logging helper across services (`log` → `logEvent`, so it stops shadowing debug helpers), plus a small tidy of the permission helpers so they share one role ordering. No behavior change intended.

 # Changelog
 
+- Internal: rename log() to logEvent().
 - 2.3.0: faster exports.
